# qualys_asset_tags (Data Source)

Look up Qualys asset tags, for referencing tags managed outside Terraform when
targeting scans, schedules, reports or web applications.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "qualys_asset_tags" "production" {
  name = "Production"
}

output "production_tag_id" {
  value = one([for t in data.qualys_asset_tags.production.tags : t.id])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.
- **name** (String) Return tags whose name exactly matches this value.
- **name_contains** (String) Return tags whose name contains this substring.
- **parent_tag_id** (String) Return tags whose parent is this tag.

### Read-Only

- **tags** (List of Object) Matching tags, ordered by ID for stable output. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
